verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is one community comment saying any field can be turned into a custom search dimension with a couple of clicks. That suggests ad-hoc filtering and grouping on arbitrary fields is possible, but it also implies a step to define the dimension (facet) first. Nothing in the pack addresses high-cardinality fields like user or request IDs specifically. Missing for 10: documentation of querying high-cardinality fields without pre-defined facets or indexes, evidence on grouping by user/request IDs at scale, and independent hands-on corroboration.
